**M8, part 2: connecting a mailbox.** `email doctor`, IMAP server presets (Mailu among them), the IMAP `ID` command, a plain-language `--manual` login prompt and policy templates.

### Pod side

- **Nothing has to change.** The asset names, the image, the policy keys and the JSON output are as in v0.7.0.
- **Run `email doctor`** in the hermes container once after the upgrade:

  ```sh
  kubectl -n hermes exec deploy/hermes-james -c hermes -- email doctor --format text \
    --notify-url http://127.0.0.1:8644/webhooks/email
  ```

  - Every line should be `ok`, or `--` for the IDLE push test, which only runs when asked.
  - Doctor is read-only. It lists one message per account but prints nothing from it, and it probes the webhook with a GET, never a POST.
  - Exit 0 means nothing failed.
- **IMAP `ID` after login**: imap accounts now identify themselves to the server with `ID ("name" "email-cli" …)`, which carries no user or host data. NetEase 163 requires it; Gmail answers it and ignores it.
- **`auth login --manual` output**: the sign-in link and what to paste back are now printed in plain words on stderr.
  - When stdout is not a terminal (as with `kubectl exec -i`), the JSON prompt still goes to stdout as before, so `--jq 'select(.authorize_url) | .authorize_url'` keeps working.
  - In a terminal, only the text is printed.
- **`watch --no-idle`** (new, optional): polls imap accounts too. Use it only if `email doctor --idle-test` shows the server accepts IDLE but does not push. Gmail pushes.

### New

- **`email doctor [-a alias]… [--idle-test 60s] [--notify-url URL] [--format text]`** checks:
  - the binary version (and whether a newer release exists);
  - that the policy file parses, and its mode;
  - that each account logs in and can list a message, with its effective mode;
  - imap: what the server offers (IDLE, CONDSTORE, Gmail extensions), and with `--idle-test`, whether it really pushes new mail;
  - the watch state files;
  - that the webhook is reachable.

  Each failure comes with a fix. Output is JSON, or `--format text`. Exit 1 when a check fails.
- **IMAP presets**: `email auth login --provider imap --preset gmail|icloud|fastmail|aliyun|qq|163|mailu`.
  - `mailu` takes `--host <your server>` (IMAP 993 and SMTP 465, implicit TLS); `--host` alone works for any server on those ports.
  - Addresses at gmail.com, icloud.com, fastmail.com, qq.com and 163.com pick their preset automatically.
  - `--preset outlook` and outlook.com/hotmail.com/live.com addresses are refused with an explanation: since September 2024 those accounts accept only OAuth for IMAP, so app passwords cannot work.
  - `auth status` shows the preset under `servers.preset`.
  - [docs/imap-presets.md](https://github.com/james-tronai/email-cli/blob/v0.8.0/docs/imap-presets.md) covers each preset.
- **Policy templates** in `docs/policy/`:
  - `read.toml`;
  - `draft.toml` (the recommended start);
  - `send-reply-only.toml` (what hermes-james runs);
  - `send-open.toml`.
- **`docs/microsoft-365-setup.md`** now describes a registration in your own tenant, with placeholders instead of the author's IDs (those remain as an example), and a separate `Mail.Send` section.
